description: Return the wallet's transaction history (txid, height, timestamp, type, network fee and per-asset balance deltas in base units). Moves no money.
name: wallet_list_transactions

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

transactions.description: Wallet transaction history, newest-first as LWK returns it.

balance.description: Net balance delta per asset, base units (signed string).

title: List transactions
